title: "I can't see a thing in here"
blurb: No wake word and no command words. The keyword baseline hears nothing; the decider turns the lights on.

steps.text: Tuesday evening. Alex is on the couch with the lights off; dusk has made the living room dim.
Alex speaks: no wake word, no command words.
I can't see a thing in here.
The keyword baseline heard no command. The decider understood the complaint (2B 67%, 12B 95%).
If the 2B was unsure the house asked first and Alex said yes on the phone; if the 12B was confident it just acted.
